cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/stress2.py <<'PYEOF'
import sys, random, time, itertools
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from compiler import build_plan, verify_plan, find_cut

seed=int(sys.argv[1]); N=int(sys.argv[2])
random.seed(seed)
maxn = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 8
bad=0; noplancut=0; both=0; plans=0; nocut=0
t0=time.time(); worst=0
for it in range(N):
    n = random.randint(3,maxn)
    nlinks = random.randint(1, min(12, n*(n-1)//2))
    pairs = random.sample(list(itertools.combinations(range(n),2)), nlinks)
    links=[]
    for (u,v) in pairs:
        links.append((u,v,random.choice([0,1,1,2,3,5,9])))
    k = random.randint(2, min(n,6))
    parts = sorted(random.sample(range(n), k))
    demand={v:0 for v in range(n)}
    tot=0
    for v in parts:
        if random.random()<0.75:
            demand[v]=random.randint(0,4); tot+=demand[v]
    if tot==0: demand[parts[0]]=random.randint(1,3)
    linkuv=[(u,v) for (u,v,c) in links]; cap=[c for (u,v,c) in links]
    t1=time.time()
    plan = build_plan(n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand)
    dt=time.time()-t1
    worst=max(worst,dt)
    cut = find_cut(n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand)
    if plan is not None:
        plans+=1
        if not verify_plan(plan, n, linkuv, cap, parts, demand):
            print("INVALID PLAN", it, links, parts, demand); bad+=1
        if cut is not None:
            print("BOTH", it, links, parts, demand, cut); both+=1
    else:
        if cut is None:
            print("NOPLAN-NOCUT", it, n, links, parts, demand); noplancut+=1
print(f"iters={N} plans={plans} bad={bad} both={both} noplancut={noplancut} worst={worst:.2f}s time={time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
PYEOF
